title: PowerPoint source-acquisition and outline-parity eval
objective: Verify that the PowerPoint workflow reads the exact named source, records resolvable citations, and produces a deck whose H1 slide titles exactly match the numbered outline before DocBlocks conversion.
prompt: Create a PowerPoint from source/brief.md for operations leads. Use 6-8 slides, preserve the supplied facts exactly, and close with next actions. Do not create HTML.

setup.about: The exact source file is authoritative; the deck must keep the locked outline and its facts.
setup.missionObjectives: Read source/brief.md, cite it, lock a numbered outline, and create matching slide-structured Markdown ready for editable PPTX conversion.

files.content:
# Boreal Desk Returns Pilot

Audience: operations leads.

Facts:
- Pilot coverage: 18 SKUs.
- Median first response: 18 hours to 6 hours.
- Preventable refund leakage: 14.2% to 8.9%.
- Top unresolved complaint: status silence after photo submission.
- Next actions: automated status emails, barcode-exception training, weekly Finance exception export.

Do not invent other metrics.

success.summary: The source packet cites the exact brief, the outline is numbered, and deck.md matches every outline slide while preserving the supplied facts.

checks.pattern: automated status emails|barcode-exception training|weekly Finance exception export

axes.name: source-acquisition
axes.description: The workflow read and cited the exact supplied source before outlining.

axes.name: outline-parity
axes.description: Every numbered outline slide appears exactly once as a same-title H1 in deck.md, in order.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Every metric and action comes from source/brief.md and no extra metric was invented.

axes.name: convertibility
axes.description: One H1 per slide and concise block content make the source ready for DocBlocks PPTX conversion.
